summary: Global markets experienced heavy selling pressure with major indices and cryptocurrencies posting significant weekly losses. The author analyzes long-term market cycles, noting that current declines echo historical correction phases. Despite the severe downturn, volume spikes and extreme price action hint at potential capitulation points. However, a true reversal requires confirmation through trend changes and sustained support levels. Overall, the speaker urges caution while monitoring macro signals and critical technical thresholds.
digest_it: I mercati globali hanno registrato forti ribassi e forti volumi di scambio in cali settimanali significativi. L'autore analizza i cicli storici per valutare la gravità della correzione, evidenziando che servono conferme tecniche prima di parlare di inversione.
tone_evidence: The speaker advises caution regarding volume spikes and stresses that confirmation through trend changes is still required before expecting a lasting market bottom.

key_points.point: S&P 500 dropped over four percent in the session, losing around three hundred twenty points.
Nasdaq fell over six percent on the session, losing more than one thousand six hundred points.
GFC peak market drop lasted seventy three weeks with a fifty eight percent value loss.
Gold broke key support near three thousand nine hundred dollars per ounce.
Bitcoin hit new lows, bringing the bear market duration to four hundred ten days.

moments.claim: Major indices suffered steep losses during the week with aggressive selling pressure.
moments.details: The S&P 500 dropped four percent while the Nasdaq fell over five percent on the session. Meanwhile, crude oil and the US dollar remained relatively flat.
moments.surprise: Nasdaq plunged more than six percent in a single session.

moments.claim: Current S&P 500 pullback is modest compared to historical bull market corrections.
moments.details: Zooming out on monthly charts, the ongoing seventeen-year bull market has experienced several twenty percent corrections. The current drop sits around twelve percent from the peak.
moments.surprise: The current twelve percent pullback remains relatively small compared to past twenty percent market reversals.

moments.topic: S&P 500 short-term price action and volume
moments.claim: Significant volume spikes indicate potential exhaustion, but trend confirmation is still lacking.
moments.details: Recent high volume suggests seller exhaustion, yet previous similar signals failed to generate sustained rebounds. A shift above seventy-one hundred twenty is required to signal a trend change.
moments.surprise: Recent volume is the highest recorded since the eleventh of June.

moments.claim: Nasdaq is witnessing record volume levels during the recent correction phase.
moments.details: The index recorded some of the highest volume in history during this decline, comparable to the Covid sell-off. A breakout above prior lows is necessary to confirm a relief rally.
moments.surprise: Trading volume reached historic highs not seen since the Covid market crash.

moments.claim: Gold broke major support at three thousand nine hundred dollars and continued lower.
moments.details: Following the breakdown, prices slipped below the fifty percent retracement level. The author is monitoring three thousand six hundred dollars and the three thousand dollar psychological mark for stabilization.
moments.surprise: Gold sliced through its key support level without immediate buyer intervention.

moments.topic: Bitcoin new lows and bear market duration
moments.claim: Bitcoin breached previous lows, extending its bear market duration.
moments.details: Bitcoin reached new lows four hundred ten days after its all-time high, aligning with typical bear market lengths. Analysts are watching sixty-seven thousand dollars as the initial resistance level for any relief rally.
moments.surprise: Bitcoin suffered sixteen consecutive days of sell-offs during this leg down.

predictions: S&P 500 could test support levels near 7120 before any sustained relief rally.
Gold may decline toward 3600 and potentially 3000 dollars per ounce if support fails.
Bitcoin could see a relief rally up to 67000 dollars before reassessing the broader trend.
curiosities: The ongoing bull market on the S&P 500 has lasted approximately seventeen years.
title: The Market Is in a Bloodbath... But Something Is Changing
author: Michael Pizzino
